NEW EVENTS - LIVING CULTURE VI: LAVASTONES AND THE SCHOOLS OF THOUGHT (LCF-01..50, draft, 2026-11-18)
Lavastones, the glowing orange-pink stones of Isola's lore, found on beaches and falling from the sky, and what they cost; and the island's schools of thought, Nature, Science, Spiritualism and Magic, arguing with and borrowing from each other.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. The owner waived the review ("I'm sure the draft events are fine"); every event passed the Isola rules and the final 15-point review, logged in the notes.

collection.description: A villager wants to use a lavastone as a wishing stone for rain: make the wish, or keep it for an emergency.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: The dry season has gone on far too long. (subject) has a small lavastone and has heard that, held in both hands at dawn, it can be used as a wishing stone. (subject.He/she) wants to wish for rain. (friend) says lavastones grant wishes in strange ways, and the village should keep it for a real emergency. What should (subject) do?

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: At dawn, (subject) holds the stone and wishes for rain. The stone grows hot, then crumbles to orange dust. By noon, it is raining. Whether the stone did it, or the season simply turned, nobody can say. (subject) has a headache for two days.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: (subject) puts the stone away. The rain comes ten days later, on its own. Some people say the stone was waiting for a real need. Some say stones do not wait for anything. The stone sits in its pouch, glowing quietly.
